title: MVR-Data
description: An Arrow-based runtime organization, interchange format, and Python toolkit for multi-vector retrieval data.

chapters.title: Welcome Page & How to Use MVR-Data
chapters.description: Install the toolkit, create raw or embedded data packages, read and validate them, and prepare archives for distribution.

chapters.title: Schema APIs & Impl
chapters.description: The schema module's callable surface and how it defines canonical Arrow representations for objects, vectors, components, and relevance judgments.

chapters.title: Manifest APIs & Impl
chapters.description: The manifest module's internal callable surface and how it creates, validates, loads, and atomically writes package metadata.

chapters.title: Writer APIs & Impl
chapters.description: Public writer APIs and how they construct Raw and Embedded packages while enforcing IDs, vector shapes, sharding, and ground-truth invariants.

chapters.title: Reader APIs & Impl
chapters.description: Public reader APIs and how they resolve trusted shard paths and stream schema-checked Arrow record batches.

chapters.title: Validation APIs & Impl
chapters.description: Public validation APIs and how they report structural, semantic, referential, judgment, and optional detailed-integrity errors.

chapters.title: Checksum APIs & Impl
chapters.description: Public checksum APIs and how they create and verify deterministic whole-package SHA-256 integrity records.

chapters.title: Packaging APIs & Impl
chapters.description: Public packaging APIs and how they create reproducible tar.zst archives and reject unsafe content during extraction.

chapters.title: CLI & Package APIs & Impl
chapters.description: The CLI and stable package APIs, plus how cli.py, __init__.py, and pyproject.toml expose them to users.
